Our Relaxing December Days in Kerala

Our relaxing beach vacation from Chennai to Kerala, December 10 to 13, felt perfectly timed with our 9-year-old son on school vacation, traveling just the three of us — myself, my wife and him.

We started with a happy, bright-smiled selfie in front of the Departures sign at the airport.

In Kerala we saw the tranquil lakeside temple reflecting beautifully on the calm water with mountains behind, and we cuddled together on the beach while watching a glowing sunset over the ocean.

We wrapped our trip with a happy selfie wearing helmets in front of lush green rice terraces.
